text: Completed trusted EyeLink ASC session materialization. The result separates lossless raw evidence from trusted sessions; verifies exact reconstructed ASC SHA-256 against declared origin; validates frame/clock/rate/eye/pupil/configuration; produces source-indexed monocular or binocular recordings without implicit eye projection; preserves vendor-native event ledgers, metadata, and stable ObservedTimeline messages; rejects HREF/RAW as named coordinate incompatibilities; and reports physical/parsed/rejected lines, typed/unknown records, samples, native records, blocks, exclusions, warnings, and errors with reconciliation checks. Empty sample-declared blocks fail closed, asymmetric blink intervals remain eye-specific, off-surface pupil loss is warned with exact raw recovery, and conversion weakness remains visible. Type-discipline review found no remaining production escape hatch, partial function, suppressed warning, stringly configuration comparison, public report-constructor hole, or stale blink call site. Full gates: io JVM 123/123, Scala.js 109/109, both scalafmt checks, git diff --check, kernel purity, and all module boundaries. Mutations killed on JVM and Scala.js: removing eye isolation relabelled the untouched binocular channel; inverting digest agreement both rejected correct provenance and admitted a mismatch. Production code restored.
